info.title: Voxi Concierge API
info.description: Agent tools for the VOX 2.0 Digital Concierge. Write tools return an action reference; results arrive via get_action_result or SSE.

language.description: Film language, e.g. English, Hindi, Arabic, Malayalam

query.description: Free-text title, actor, keyword. Fuzzy matched.

rating.description: Classification such as G, PG, PG13, PG15, 15+, 18+

maxAge.description: Customer's child age; filters to suitable ratings

cinemaName.description: Cinema or mall name, fuzzy matched, e.g. 'Mall of the Emirates', 'MOE', 'Deira' — or an emirate ('Dubai', 'Abu Dhabi', 'Sharjah') to search every cinema there

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or a word: today, tomorrow, friday, weekend. Defaults to today (Dubai time). Do not compute dates yourself — pass the word.

nearMe.description: Search the cinemas nearest to the location the guest shared/picked in the widget (never invent coordinates)

suggestAlternatives.description: If nothing matches, relax filters and return alternatives

bank.description: Only offers for this bank/card when the guest names one, e.g. 'ENBD', 'Emirates NBD', 'HSBC', 'ADCB'

cardBin.description: First 6 digits of a card the guest mentioned — filters to offers that card qualifies for

bookingId.description: Vista booking id / reference, e.g. WL59LFJ

verification.description: Identity check for guests: last 4 digits of the phone on the booking, or the booking email. Not needed when the logged-in customer owns the booking.
Identity check for guests: last 4 digits of the phone on the booking, or the booking email. Not needed when the logged-in customer owns the booking.

tab.description: Combos | Popcorn | Drinks | Snacks | Hot Food | Desserts | Kids | GOLD Menu

method.description: SAVED_CARD when the customer requests a saved card ('my saved Mastercard', 'the Visa ending 2211', 'my usual card'). CARD opens general payment options when no method is chosen; an available saved card may be preselected and the customer chooses in the secure sheet. APPLE_PAY / SAMSUNG_PAY for wallets; VOX_CREDIT / SHARE_POINTS for members' balances. Opening the sheet does not authorize a charge.

customer.description: Omit for signed-in members: checkout uses their verified profile. Guests enter contact details in the secure payment sheet; supply only details they explicitly provided, never guesses.

language.description: Film language when the guest specified one

title.description: Movie title as the guest said it (fuzzy matched)

cinemaName.description: Cinema/mall the guest named ('MOE', 'Deira', 'Yas Mall'). Omit when not stated — the tool uses the member's usual cinema or the shared location.

useUsualCinema.description: Legacy compatibility flag. An inferred usual cinema is used automatically unless the guest names another cinema.

date.description: today (default), tonight, tomorrow, weekday or YYYY-MM-DD — pass the word, never compute

time.description: Target time HH:mm in 24h for 'around 8', 'at 9 pm', 'evening' (use 19:30) — a ±30 min window is searched, nearest first

experience.description: Only when the guest asked for it (IMAX, MAX, GOLD…). Default Standard unless the profile prefers otherwise.

tickets.description: Adult ticket count explicitly supplied by the guest; omit when unknown so the tool asks

sessionKey.description: Book this exact showtime (from a showtimes/alternatives card) — skips film/cinema/time resolution

userSessionId.description: The expired/active order; defaults to the conversation's order

confirmed.description: true only after the guest explicitly agrees to create a new hold; never set automatically on expiry or resume

bookingId.description: Booking the food is for (after tickets are paid) — defaults to the booking just made
Booking the food is for; defaults to the booking just made in this conversation

repeatUsual.description: true when the guest said 'the same as last time' — items may then be omitted

language.description: Film language the guest asked for (Tamil, Hindi, Arabic…) — overrides profile history

withChildren.description: Use only when already known or needed for a ticket/age decision; true includes family films. Do not add a children question to broad recommendations.

cinemaName.description: Cinema explicitly named by the guest, overriding the inferred preferred cinema

time.description: Explicit target time in 24-hour HH:mm, overriding preferred timing

confirmationId.description: From prepare_cancellation; proves the summary was read to the customer

autoAllocate.description: If true, ignore `seats` and let the system pick best available adjacent seats

quantity.description: Quantity to have in the order for this item; 0 removes the item (use it to swap a drink the guest rejected)

paymentToken.description: Token from the widget payment sheet (simulated Checkout). Never a PAN.

summary.description: Agent-written summary; the middleware appends structured context

post.summary: Search movies (now showing, coming soon, advance booking) by title, actor, genre, language, rating or child age. Returns posters and trailers for cards.
Get full details for one movie: synopsis, cast, runtime, rating, languages, trailer.
Find showtimes for a movie and/or cinema on a date with optional experience, time window and language filters. Suggests alternatives when nothing matches.
List VOX cinemas, optionally by emirate or experience.
Cinema details: address, opening hours, experiences, parking, in-mall directions, accessibility.

Three nearest cinemas to the location the guest shared or picked in the widget (no coordinates needed — never invent any). If it returns LOCATION_REQUIRED, ask the guest to tap the location button or name an area, or call request_location.
Age restriction rules by rating and experience (e.g. GOLD/THEATRE 18+ policies) and whether a child of a given age may attend.
Available promotions and offers (bank, promo codes, Share Points, VOX Rewards) with images, eligibility and remaining balance.
Check if an offer applies to a session, member or card.
Explain how to book and return deep links to the booking page for a movie/session.
Find existing bookings by booking reference, email, phone or member id. Returns booking summary, tickets, seats, refund eligibility.
Evaluate the cancellation & refund policy for a booking (cut-off, used tickets, F&B, offers) and compute refund amount per method.
Create the cancellation summary the customer must confirm (refund amount, method). Returns confirmationId. ALWAYS read the summary to the customer before cancel_booking.
Prepare a swap to a different showtime: availability, price difference, refund/charge summary. Returns confirmationId.
Fetch the outcome of a previously requested action (cancellation, refund, swap, order step, payment, transfer). Waits briefly for completion.
Food & beverage menu per cinema/experience with prices, combos, images and dietary filters (vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free).
Ticket types and prices for a session (adult, child, student, premium view...).

Seat map and availability for a session; renders the interactive seat map in the widget and returns 2–3 suggested seats per area (front/middle/back) with their tier and price so you can offer choices instead of picking.
Current order (cart) summary: tickets, seats, F&B, offers, totals, expiry.

Create the payment summary the customer must confirm. For CARD / SAVED_CARD / APPLE_PAY / SAMSUNG_PAY it opens the secure Review & Pay sheet in the widget — the guest completes payment there and you do NOT call pay_order. For VOX_CREDIT / SHARE_POINTS read the summary, get a yes, then call pay_order with the confirmationId. Never read the confirmationId aloud.

Book from the guest's stated movie, cinema, date, time, ticket count and seat preference. Explicit choices override history. Uses the inferred cinema when not stated. Unknown ticket count returns needs:tickets and a quantity selector without holding seats. Once known, holds seats and shows a compact order review with optional snacks before one payment. Unavailable shows return alternatives. Returns the result inline; repeated idempotencyKey replays it.

Inspect an earlier booking. A valid hold keeps its original expiry and is offered for continuation. An expired hold returns expired:true and fresh-booking choices; this tool never creates or renews a hold.

Create a fresh hold only after the guest explicitly agrees (confirmed:true). Rechecks the show is future and on sale, then attempts the same or nearest seats and restores food/offers. An expired timer or resume alone is not consent. Returns the result inline.
Offer a few usual/popular snacks and a skip option before payment. Also supports adding food separately after ticket payment. Browse the full menu only on request.

Add the selected food to an active unpaid ticket basket for one combined payment. After ticket payment, create a separate food order. Omit items only when repeatUsual:true was explicitly requested. Returns the result inline.
Share Points and VOX Rewards balance for the logged-in member.
Whether the customer is logged in, their name, preferred language, location permission and any active order.
Open the secure sign-in form. Never ask for an email/password in conversation or send credentials through an agent tool.
Bookings for the logged-in customer.
Personalised movie and F&B recommendations from profile preferences and purchase history.
Cancel a booking and trigger the refund exactly as summarised in prepare_cancellation. Requires confirmationId and confirmed=true.
Execute the prepared swap (refund original, rebook new session). Requires confirmationId and confirmed=true.
Start a new booking order for a session. Returns userSessionId.
Add tickets to the order.
Choose specific seats (or auto-allocate) for the tickets in the order.
Add food & beverage items to the order, or remove one with quantity 0. Only add what the guest explicitly chose — never a guess.
Apply an offer or promo code to the order.
Redeem Share Points or VOX Rewards against the order.

Complete payment and create the booking (QR + reference) for VOX_CREDIT or SHARE_POINTS payments only — card, saved card, Apple Pay and Samsung Pay are completed by the guest in the widget's payment sheet, so never call this for those. Requires confirmationId and confirmed=true.
Abandon the in-progress order and release seats.
Record the end-of-chat feedback rating.
Log a customer complaint with the details gathered in conversation.
Hand the conversation to a human agent with a summary. Use on explicit request, frustration, or after two failed answers.
Mark a journey (e.g. 'movie_info', 'cancellation') completed or abandoned for reporting.
